universe: All regular-season games in the stored official log (data/origin/games.csv, 183 verified finals) for research; the live universe is the rolling window of official schedule games priced at most three days ahead (data/app/official_slate_1115_1118.json and successors).
settlement_rule: Settle from the OFFICIAL final score only (nba.com scoreboard / official game book; quarter sums must equal the printed final). A side pick on team T at our originated line covers when (T score - opponent score + line_for_T) > 0; a total pick wins when the official combined final crosses our originated total. Games must reach Final; void otherwise. Pushes settle as void (stake returned, no P&L). No closing line is used for settlement — our own originated line is the reference, frozen at publication and hashed in the pick ledger (data/app/ledger/ledger.jsonl).
note: No strategy is funded and no money bet has been placed; this file is the pre-registration of the research rules (T1 tier) as published on the strategy leaderboard.
